comment: A design for tools/ui-scripts/extrude-thin-open-curve.mitcad-ui (mitcad#2594): Sketch1 (F1) on XY with an open spline by its control points (0, 0), (20, 20) and (40, 0), degree 2 (c1, its points p2 to p4; 45.9 mm long; a spline drawn through points is not yet walled, mitcad#2594), and a 20 x 10 rectangle from (60, -5) beside it, whose profile Extrude takes by itself when it starts.
